objective.name: sandbox.sleep.echo
objective.description: Wrapper-backed delayed echo for N5 stop-during-flight tests

#root.role: Sleep inside the wrapper runtime, then return an echoed message.

effects.wrapper_runtime: The wrapper runtime holds the request in flight for the requested delay.

transformation_contract.morphing: A delayed echo request becomes an echoed message only after the wrapper runtime has held the request for the requested delay.
invariants: delay_ms is coerced to an integer and values less than or equal to zero yield no sleep.
After any optional delay, the capability delegates payload shaping to the same echo semantics as sandbox.echo.
The capability does not mutate engine or wrapper state beyond holding the request in flight.
success: On success, sandbox.sleep.echo returns the same payload shape as sandbox.echo after the requested delay has elapsed.
The returned ctx_id and wrapper_name still identify the active local wrapper runtime.
failure: sandbox.sleep.echo has no contract-level validation failure for missing message or delay_ms because defaults are applied locally.
The capability only fails if the underlying async wrapper runtime cannot execute or complete the wait.
notes: This capability is used to exercise in-flight timing and concurrency scenarios while keeping the payload semantics identical to sandbox.echo.
delay_ms is measured inside the wrapper runtime, not by the engine scheduler.
